xna-type.name: TouchPanel
xna-type.summary: Provides methods for retrieving touch panel device information.

property.name: DisplayHeight
property.summary: Gets or sets the display height of the touch panel.
property.syntax: public static int DisplayHeight { get; set; }

property.name: DisplayOrientation
property.summary: Gets or sets the display orientation of the touch panel.
property.syntax: public static DisplayOrientation DisplayOrientation { get; set; }

property.name: DisplayWidth
property.summary: Gets or sets the display width of the touch panel.
property.syntax: public static int DisplayWidth { get; set; }

property.name: EnabledGestures
property.summary: Gets or sets the gestures that are enabled for the touch panel.
property.syntax: public static GestureType EnabledGestures { get; set; }

property.name: IsGestureAvailable
property.summary: Used to determine if a touch gesture is available.
property.remarks: Before gestures can become available, they first must be set with the TouchPanel.EnabledGestures property. If IsGestureAvailable is true , TouchPanel.ReadGesture can be used to read the gesture data.

property.name: WindowHandle
property.summary: The window handle of the touch panel.
property.syntax: public static IntPtr WindowHandle { get; set; }

method.name: GetCapabilities
method.summary: Gets the touch panel capabilities for an available device.

overload.summary: Gets the touch panel capabilities for an available device.
overload.returns: Information about the capabilities of the touch panel device.

method.name: GetState
method.summary: Gets the current state of the touch panel.

overload.summary: Gets the current state of the touch panel.
overload.returns: State of the touch panel and any existing touch locations.

method.name: ReadGesture
method.summary: Reads an available gesture on the touch panel.

overload.summary: Reads an available gesture on the touch panel.
overload.returns: A GestureSample that represents the next gesture to read.
overload.remarks: After reading a gesture, TouchPanel.IsGestureAvailable is true if there are more gestures to read.
